title: Chronology of the Andalusian-European Knowledge Transmission

eras.title: The Raymondine Foundation Era in Toledo
eras.focus: Philosophical treatises of Ibn Sīnā, Al-Fārābī, and Andalusian mathematical primers.

eras.title: The Golden Age of Gerard of Cremona
eras.focus: Monumental translation of over 70 scientific masterworks including Al-Zahrāwī's Chirurgia, Al-Zarqālī's Toledo Tables, Jabir ibn Aflah's astronomy, Euclid's Elements, and Ptolemy's Almagest from Arabic.

eras.title: The Averroistic Wave & Imperial Patronage
eras.patron: Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II & Kings of Castile
eras.focus: İbn Rüşd's Great and Middle Commentaries on Aristotle; Al-Biṭrūjī's homocentric cosmology.

eras.title: The Alfonsine Scriptorium and Castilian Vernacularization
eras.patron: King Alfonso X of Castile (El Sabio)
eras.focus: Creation of the Tablas Alfonsíes (Alfonsine Tables), Libros del Saber de Astronomía, translating directly from Arabic into Castilian and Latin.
